In this new episode of Sail-Ho we are visiting Dugi Otok, the longest and biggest island of the Zadar archipelago. It is also the 2nd most indented island in all of the Adriatic Sea, with gorgeous beaches and beautiful nature we believe is worth exploring completely.

Welcome to Sail-Ho Croatia! We're in Rab, the island known by many as the island of love and happiness since Roman times. It has more than 30 sandy beaches, 2500 hours of sunshine and a mouthwatering gastronomy. Come join us and find out why this place is considered a happy place by so many.

The three-day event of the FNB Dusi Canoe Marathon is back again for the 2016 edition. Participants competing for the podium will have to trust their partners, be the best at route scouting and keep their focus until the very last moment, a task that is not easy at all.

Welcome to Prague in the Czech Republic for the final of the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup. The five-race series culminates over the course of this weekend with double points up for grabs to determine who will be crowned the 2019 ICF Canoe Slalom World Cup winner.

In this episode we are in La Seu D'Urgell, in the Spanish Pyrenees, for the 2019 International Canoe Slalom World Championships. We started off with athletes from 63 nations competing for the title. Now, 8 nations remain in this 10-boat final in La Seu d'Urgell.

In this episode we’ll be flying back to Europe, to watch the 2019 Formula Kite European Championships in Italy. Taking place in the Mediterranean track, Oristano Gulf welcomes kiteboarding in an event that will be as plastic free as possible.
